title: %zscore — standard score of a value
purpose: Express how many population standard deviations a value lies from a dataset's mean.
notes: Uses the population standard deviation of the dataset; here mean 80, std ~7.07, so 85 is ~0.71 std above.
Argument order is the value first, then the dataset array.
If every dataset value is identical the standard deviation is 0 and the result is ~ (null).
